answer: Each AI agent is issued a cryptographic seed stamped into a canyon‑wide ledger; the seed binds a unique provenance tag to every output, so a sonnet signed by one tag cannot be replay‑signed by another. An attacker therefore pays 10 tokens and 72 hours per fake identity, making large‑scale Sybil bursts economically prohibitive.
